summary: Reviewed 37 units of p02 ch08 k1 word by word against the Sanskrit and the Devanagari. Structure, splits, identifications (dūrvā, indīvara, śara, padma, palāśa, karṇikāra) and the damaged-print handling (u12, u14, u19, u35 unsplit and unclear, guesses only in flags) are sound. Fixes: adopted typo conjectures not marked in the translations (u3, u15, u25, u27); damaged words wrongly attached/supplied (u14 'of unclear kind', u19 क्थति); Hindi that reverses or adds (u24 'सहारा' of the lords, u27 'अंगों', u33 'प्रकृति', u34 'व्यक्ति', u35 feminine for masculine); hedges for dhamanī (u17); '(ones)' for unstated nouns; compound stems and one gram. No identification judged wrong. Items without patch are open observations for the owner (u3 womb/uterus and confidence, u15 stena and readings, u21/u27/u37 conjectural-mark policy, u27 uru, u29 medhā, u30 sthūlalakṣa, u36 reading). No regrouping suggested; u35-u37 form one running argument and u16/u22/u28 are 'api ca' links.
glossary_suggestions: (p02 ch08 k1) prakṛti in the constitution chapter = 'constitution (prakṛti)'; vikṛti = abnormality; dhamanī in Vāta description = 'probably the visible veins' hedged in both languages.

(p02 ch08 k1) Typo conjectures adopted in a translation (madhurāmla, pūti-gandhi, kṣut-pipāsā, bahu-ojas, anārogya, su-vibhakta) carry 'on a conjectural reading' / 'अनुमानित पाठ पर' next to the conjectural word; damaged words with no sound conjecture stay 'unclear' / 'अस्पष्ट पद' with the printed Devanagari form.

(p02 ch08 k1) karabha = 'camel or young elephant' / 'ऊँट या हाथी का बच्चा'; karṇikāra probable Pterospermum acerifolium (कनकचम्पा), Cassia fistula the other proposal; indīvara probable blue lotus (नीला कमल); śara probable reed (सरकंडा); gāndharva = music (गान्धर्व यानी संगीत).

(p02 ch08 k1) OPEN: stena 'a thief' (u15); mahā- over forehead/thighs/arms vs uru 'broad' (u27); medhā vs meha (u29); sthūlalakṣa 'large-aimed' vs 'liberal' (u30); garbhāśaya womb vs uterus book-wide.
(p02 ch08 k1) Compound members in `w` take the stem (ojas, āyus), not the nominative with visarga.
